environment.description: Spring Boot service deployed on EC2 instances behind an internal ALB in VPC subnet 10.0.1.0/24. Service is registered in internal Route53 hosted zone as admin-svc.internal.corp. Security groups allow inbound on port 8080 from 10.0.0.0/16 CIDR. Any host within the VPC (including developer workstations, CI runners, compromised instances) can reach the service directly. No additional request filtering or header stripping is applied at the ALB layer.

config.load_balancer: internal ALB, no header manipulation rules
config.authentication: HTTP Basic with Spring Security (user credentials in RDS)
